entries.symptom: xcodebuild -version prints another Xcode than the pinned one, or a built app has an unexpected DTXcode
entries.cause: /Applications/Xcode.app is another version on this Mac, and a tool used it because DEVELOPER_DIR was not set, or someone ran xcode-select
entries.fix: Select the pinned Xcode per process with DEVELOPER_DIR (the toolchain helper does); never run xcode-select -s, which changes every session on the machine

entries.symptom: Black screen at launch after building with an Xcode newer than the pinned one on Expo SDK 57
entries.cause: The newer iOS SDK expects the UIScene life cycle, which SDK 57 apps do not adopt by default
entries.fix: Stay on the pinned Xcode until the SDK upgrade; if a newer Xcode is required, add ['expo-build-properties', { ios: { enableSceneSupport: true } }] (expo 57.0.23 or newer) and prove the launch on a simulator

entries.symptom: You have not agreed to the Xcode license agreements
entries.cause: The selected Xcode was installed but its licence was never accepted
entries.fix: Human step: the developer runs sudo <Xcode>/Contents/Developer/usr/bin/xcodebuild -license accept in their own terminal (an agent never runs sudo)

entries.symptom: xcrun: error: unable to find utility "simctl"
entries.cause: DEVELOPER_DIR (or xcode-select) points at the Command Line Tools, not at an Xcode app
entries.fix: Point DEVELOPER_DIR at <Xcode>.app/Contents/Developer for the process (the toolchain helper does)

entries.symptom: ** BUILD FAILED ** in a pod: a precompiled .pcm "was compiled with module cache path" of another folder, then "missing required module 'SwiftShims'"
entries.cause: The repo was copied or moved: the build cleaned ios/ but kept its DerivedData folder, whose module cache still names the old path
entries.fix: Delete this app's own DerivedData folder (the build output folder the build script names), then rerun the same build; after copying a repo, delete its build folders and ios/ before the first build
match: was compiled with module cache path

entries.symptom: pod install fails downloading a pod (Google-Mobile-Ads-SDK, GoogleUserMessagingPlatform, a Skia or IAP pod): Failed to download, CDN: trunk, Couldn't connect to server
entries.cause: Pods are downloaded at prebuild time; no network or a CDN problem
entries.fix: Retry once after a few minutes; never loosen pod versions or edit the Podfile.lock by hand

entries.symptom: pod install fails: react-native-skia: Skia prebuilt binaries not found
entries.cause: @shopify/react-native-skia downloads its prebuilt Skia libraries in an install step that did not run (install scripts not approved, or an offline install)
entries.fix: Run npx install-skia (after reading what it fetches), or approve the package install script per the dependency policy, then prebuild again

entries.symptom: No .xcworkspace in ios/ after prebuild
entries.cause: The prebuild stopped early on a config error
entries.fix: Read the prebuild log the build wrote, fix the config error, rerun npx expo prebuild --platform ios --clean

entries.symptom: xcodebuild cannot find the workspace or scheme named after package.json
entries.cause: The workspace and scheme come from expo.name with spaces and punctuation removed, not from the package name
entries.fix: Discover ios/*.xcworkspace after prebuild and derive the scheme from it

entries.symptom: Signing for "<App>" requires a development team (on a simulator build)
entries.cause: CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO is missing from the simulator build
entries.fix: Simulator builds never sign: Release, -sdk iphonesimulator, -destination id=<udid>, CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO

entries.symptom: ** BUILD FAILED ** with a Swift, Objective-C or C++ error inside a pod
entries.cause: A native module and the SDK disagree, usually after a version change made by hand
entries.fix: npx expo install --check, restore the pinned versions, then prebuild with --clean; a library that still fails needs an update (dependency-management)

entries.symptom: npx expo run:ios made a Debug build (dev menu, JS from Metro) with whatever Xcode xcode-select points at
entries.cause: expo run:ios builds Debug for the default Xcode and picks a simulator itself
entries.fix: Build the evidence build with the build skill's script (Release, iphonesimulator, CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO, DEVELOPER_DIR, a named simulator)

entries.symptom: simctl io <udid> screenshot /dev/null fails: Operation not permitted
entries.cause: simctl cannot write its PNG to /dev/null
entries.fix: Write to a temporary file and delete it

entries.symptom: A screenshot right after simctl bootstatus -b is black with a small spinner
entries.cause: bootstatus returns while SpringBoard is still starting
entries.fix: Wait for the app's ready signal (two identical screenshots a few seconds apart) before the screenshot that counts

entries.symptom: A system banner ("Ready for Apple Intelligence" or similar) covers the app on a new simulator
entries.cause: One-time system banner on the first launch after simctl create
entries.fix: Warm a new simulator up once and discard its first capture

entries.symptom: The status bar shows a 24-hour time or a charging bolt after simctl status_bar override --time 9:41
entries.cause: The simulator inherited the Mac region; --batteryState charged draws a bolt; overrides reset on every reboot
entries.fix: xcrun simctl spawn <udid> defaults write -g AppleLocale -string en_US, reboot, re-apply; use --batteryState discharging --batteryLevel 100 after every boot

entries.symptom: simctl status_bar rejects --time "9:41 AM": Invalid, non-ISO date/time string
entries.cause: Only 9:41 style or an ISO date with milliseconds is accepted
entries.fix: Use --time 9:41 (or an ISO time such as ...T09:41:00.000Z)

entries.symptom: "Open in <App>?" alert after simctl openurl; testIDs vanish from the Maestro hierarchy
entries.cause: iOS asks before opening a custom scheme from simctl openurl, nothing accepts the prompt, and pending alerts queue and dim the app
entries.fix: Open debug and deep links through Maestro's openLink in a sub-flow that waits for the alert animation, taps Open, and taps again if the alert is still there; never send them with simctl openurl

entries.symptom: A launch argument such as -AppleLanguages "(ar)" stored in a shell variable is ignored
entries.cause: zsh does not word-split $ARGS, so the words arrive as one argument
entries.fix: Pass each word as its own argument (an argument array in the script, never a string)

entries.symptom: xcrun simctl launch <udid> <bundleId> -AppleLanguages "(ar)" still shows the app in English or left to right
entries.cause: The app does not declare the language (no CFBundleLocalizations entry), or the argument arrived as one word
entries.fix: Configure expo-localization's supportedLocales with the app's locales so prebuild writes CFBundleLocalizations; pass each launch argument as its own word

entries.symptom: simctl create "<device name>" fails: the device type is not in the runtime
entries.cause: Each iOS runtime ships its own device list (a new runtime drops older models)
entries.fix: List the device types with xcrun simctl list devicetypes for the installed runtime, and name the model in the build contract

entries.symptom: Another session's simulator was shut down, erased or reached by this session's command
entries.cause: simctl shutdown all / erase all / delete all, or a command that targets "booted", touch every simulator on the machine
entries.fix: Name simulators <project>-<purpose>, target them by UDID, shut down and delete only your own

entries.symptom: simctl boot exits with "Unable to boot device due to insufficient system resources" (maxUserProcs / runningUserProcs)
entries.cause: Too many simulators are booted on the machine, other sessions included, so the per-user process limit is reached
entries.fix: Shut down only this session's own simulators that are not needed now (xcrun simctl shutdown <udid>), then rerun; never shutdown all

entries.symptom: Unable to boot device in current state: Booted
entries.cause: The simulator was already booted
entries.fix: Harmless: use xcrun simctl bootstatus <udid> -b, which boots only when needed
match: Unable to boot device in current state: Booted

entries.symptom: No space left on device, or a simulator will not boot
entries.cause: Old DerivedData, build folders, runtimes and unavailable simulators
entries.fix: Delete this repo's build output and run xcrun simctl delete unavailable; never erase simulators the tooling did not create

entries.symptom: The build script reports that the app was not ready after its timeout
entries.cause: A JS error before the first screen, or the ready signal the script waits for never comes (a first-run screen that never reaches the expected screen)
entries.fix: Open the last screenshot, read the process log (xcrun simctl spawn <udid> log show --last 2m --predicate 'process == "<Executable>"'), fix the error; the ready signal falls back to a still screen

entries.symptom: An app whose main.jsbundle was swapped for fast iteration fails to install or launch
entries.cause: The bundle changed after the app was signed (even ad hoc)
entries.fix: After copying the new bundle run codesign --force --sign - --deep <App>.app, then install and launch by UDID; the evidence build is always the full Release run
